rows: - 24 Nov, saved-draft iOS visual replay (n=1, no model). Normal draft storage produced Saved in 12 captures, and the normalized RGB comparison took 3.17 s for all 12. At two decimal places, ten frames had a lower percentage of pixels at or above a 24-level channel difference, one stayed the same, and the settled language picker rose from 5.23% to 6.57%. Keep the saved-draft replay for these states so the capture includes the same save indicator as the recording.
